text:
harry: Heads-up - PanEuro Partners submitted invoice PE-2026-05 and they've included VAT on top of our marketplace gross amount for multiple EU customers. Our expectation is reverse-charge (0% VAT) for B2B intra-EU marketplace purchases when we have valid VAT IDs. Their invoice shows VAT line €4,320. Can tax-ops confirm whether we owe this or they should reissue without VAT?

sana: I checked our customer VAT table. We have valid EU VAT IDs on file for the affected accounts (DE-449, FR-221, NL-772). PanEuro's exported invoice lists the customers but their VAT column is blank. Snapshot: 

```
invoice_id,customer_id,net_eur,vat_pct,vat_eur,gross_eur
PE-2026-05,DE-449,15000,0,0,15000
PE-2026-05,FR-221,8200,0,0,8200
PE-2026-05,NL-772,12000,0,0,12000
PE-2026-05,COMBINED,35200,12.27,4320,39520
```

irina: If partner incorrectly applied VAT, they should issue a corrected invoice without VAT (reverse-charge) and include their correction note. Alternatively, if they insist VAT was collected on their side, we need proof they remitted VAT to the local tax authority and then we can claim a credit. Prefer corrected invoice.

tax-ops: Agreed. Policy: for B2B intra-EU, we require partner to apply reverse-charge if VAT IDs are on file. Action: request PanEuro to (A) reissue PE-2026-05 as net-only invoices with reverse-charge note, or (B) provide VAT remittance evidence for €4,320 if they already paid. We'll hold the VAT portion until resolved.

harry: For month-close we must avoid misclassifying expense and VAT. Recommend we record a provisional payable hold for the VAT amount (liability) rather than paying the VAT to partner, pending corrected invoice or remittance docs. Post JV to move VAT -> VAT Payable ledger GL 2-330 with memo "holding VAT pending vendor corrected invoice / remittance PE-2026-05". Anyone object?

sana: +1. Also flag AR/AP aging so payments team doesn't auto-pay the gross amount. Put payment on hold with payments ops.

billing-bot: Provisional JV created: JV-2026-0810, amount €4,320, GL 2-330, status: PENDING_VENDOR_CONFIRMATION, ticket: FIN-4789.

irina: We'll draft a vendor message asking for corrected invoices and include a 10 business day SLA. Also request their VAT reg numbers and remittance evidence if they claim they already paid.

harry: Draft message (for records):

```
Subject: PE-2026-05 - VAT on marketplace invoice
Hi PanEuro billing team,

Thanks for the invoice. We have valid EU VAT IDs on file for the customers on PE-2026-05 and our policy is reverse-charge for B2B intra-EU marketplace transactions. Your PDF shows VAT of 4,320. Please either: (A) reissue corrected invoice(s) showing net amounts with reverse-charge notation, or (B) provide proof of VAT remittance for 4,320.

We have placed the VAT portion on hold (JV-2026-0810) pending your response. Please send corrected documents to billing@redwood.ai within 10 business days so we can reconcile and release the hold.

Best,
Harry (Finance)
```

tax-ops: Adding note: if vendor reissues corrected invoice, we will reverse JV-2026-0810 and clear the payable. If they provide remittance evidence, we may accept and then recognize VAT as cost with supporting docs.

sana: I've notified payments ops to block the payment run for PE-2026-05. Ticket PAY-1902 opened.

billing-bot: Ticket created: PAY-1902, assigned payments-ops; FIN-4789 updated with vendor response pending.

harry: Thanks all. Leave thread open until corrected invoice or remittance docs attached to FIN-4789. :white_check_mark:
